title: The Resignation Tadashi Yanai Refused When the Vegetables Failed
conflicts: Loss figures: Yunoki (Hitotsubashi 2018, Diamond 2014) says 2.6 billion yen; Diamond 2016 and TV Tokyo 2020 say more than 2 billion; Fast Retailing's 2004 accounts show a 1.0 billion yen extraordinary loss plus 1.8 billion yen of termination payments; Japan Times (March 2004, blocked, not cited) reported a planned 2.8 billion yen special loss. Story uses Yunoki's figure, attributed to him. Yanai's reply exists in three Japanese wordings, so it is paraphrased. GU presidency dated 2010 (TV Tokyo) or 2011 (Hitotsubashi profile, with GOV Retailing in 2010); story says he was running it by 2010.
notes: The episode centres on Yanai's response to the closure: the SKIP venture itself was led by Osamu Yunoki (FR Foods president), so both are named as founders. Japanese/Chinese sources and the company PDFs load but the verifier cannot match names in them; three sources are OK (Fast Retailing history, just-food, Global Views). Japan Times and Retail Week, the main English contemporary reports, block automated readers.
